title: NeuralFlow Pipeline
description: Schema v2 for a NeuralFlow pipeline file. Loops are subgraphs, ports are typed, no secrets or device pins stored.

PortType.description: Allowed data types for node ports.

name.description: Port identifier, unique within the node's input or output list.

NodeType.description: Allowed node types. 'access' was added in schema 2.1.

AccessPolicy.description: Capabilities granted to every node downstream of an access node. Deny-by-default. Added in schema 2.1. When several access nodes are ancestors of one node their policies intersect — the most restrictive wins.

providers.description: Cloud/model providers downstream nodes may call. Empty grants none.

allow_local_models.description: Whether downstream nodes may call a local Ollama endpoint.

allow_network.description: Whether downstream nodes may make general network calls.

allowed_domains.description: Hostnames reachable when allow_network is true. Empty means no domain restriction.

max_cost_usd.description: USD ceiling for this scope. null means no policy ceiling.

max_tokens.description: Per-request token ceiling for this scope.

custom_node_id.description: ID of the custom node definition this node was created from.

custom_label.description: Display label overriding the node type name.

custom_color.description: Hex accent color for a custom node.

api_field.description: Name of this input/output node in a deployment's request or response body (schema 2.1, Phase 3).

api_expose.description: Output nodes only: whether this node's value is included in a deployment's response. Defaults to true.

StopOp.description: Allowed comparison operators in stop_when conditions. No raw code or eval.

StopCondition.description: Structured stop condition — no raw code or eval permitted.

field.description: Dot-path to the field being tested, e.g. 'verify.output.verified'.

value.description: Scalar value to compare against. Must be a primitive (string, number, boolean).

OnMax.description: Policy when a loop reaches max_iterations without satisfying stop_when.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this pipeline.

endpoint_ref.description: Key into the top-level endpoints map. Required for 'model' nodes, forbidden on others. No secrets stored here.

Loop.description: A bounded loop subgraph. Must have a finite max_iterations — no infinite loops.

body.description: Ordered list of node IDs that form the loop body.

max_iterations.description: Hard upper bound on iterations. Enforced by the scheduler as a kill switch.

Edge.description: Directed edge connecting one node's output port to another node's input port.

EndpointDescriptor.description: Endpoint descriptor. No API keys, credentials, or device pins stored here — resolved at runtime from OS keychain.

base_url.description: Optional override base URL for openai_compatible or ollama endpoints.

model.description: Default model name for this endpoint reference.

schema_version.description: Pipeline format version. '2.1' added the access node; a '2.0' document is still valid and is read as a pipeline with no access node.

version.description: Semantic version of this pipeline file, e.g. '1.0.0'.

loops.description: Loop subgraph definitions. Omit if no loops.

edges.description: Directed edges between node ports. Format: 'nodeId.portName'.

endpoints.description: Named endpoint registry. Keys are the endpoint_ref values used by model nodes.
